item.title: Pydantic AI Skills Enhances Agent Capabilities with Progressive Disclosure
item.description:
Pydantic AI Skills Enhances Agent Capabilities with Progressive Disclosure

Pydantic AI Skills introduces enhanced capabilities for Agent Skills, supporting progressive disclosure and modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. This update allows agents to handle specialized tasks more efficiently by loading only the necessary resources when needed.

🔍 Overview

  • Pydantic AI Skills enhances Agent Skills with progressive disclosure.
  • Supports filesystem and programmatic skills.
  • Enables remote skill registries and bundled-file execution.

🧩 How it works

  • Agent Skills are modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts.
  • On disk, a skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file, reference documents, and executable scripts.
  • Your agent starts with only the name and description of each skill.
  • When a task calls for a skill, it loads the full instructions and resources only if needed.
  • This is progressive disclosure, allowing the skill library to grow without every skill paying for space in the prompt.

⚙️ Key details

  • pydantic-ai-harness ships a Skills capability that reads SKILL.md packages from local directories.
  • pydantic-ai-skills is the companion that fills the gaps, including remote registries and bundled-file execution.
  • Remote registries support Git and S3 sources, with composition features.
  • Bundled files can be read or executed with read_skill_resource and run_skill_script.
  • Sandboxed execution keeps untrusted scripts off the host.
  • ${SKILL_DIR} resolution substitutes the path in scripts.
  • Programmatic skills can be defined in Python within the same catalog.
  • v2 introduces SkillsToolset, SkillsDirectory, reload(), and tools for listing and loading skills.
  • Each skill becomes its own deferred capability, with names and descriptions acting as fields the runtime uses.

💡 Why it matters

  • Progressive disclosure allows the skill library to grow without every skill paying for space in the prompt.
  • Enhanced capabilities for handling specialized tasks more efficiently.
  • Supports remote skill registries and bundled-file execution.
  • Sandboxed execution ensures security for untrusted scripts.

#PydanticAI #AgentSkills #ProgressiveDisclosure #AIAgents #AITools

Source: DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills

item.title: PineScript Expert Agent and ReAgent Archival Update
item.description:
PineScript Expert Agent and ReAgent Archival Update

Two recent developments in the AI and reinforcement learning space have been noted: the release of a RAG-based Pine Script expert agent built with Pydantic AI, and the official archival of the ReAgent reinforcement learning platform in favor of Pearl.

📗 PineScript Expert Agent

PineScript Expert is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agent developed using Pydantic AI that serves as an expert on Pine Script v6, the programming language used for custom indicators and strategies on TradingView. The system leverages vector search technology and large language models to provide accurate, context-aware answers and generate working code examples.

Key Features

  • Comprehensive Knowledge: Accesses the entire Pine Script v6 documentation through natural language queries using a custom crawler.
  • Code Generation: Creates custom indicators and strategies based on specific user requirements.
  • Interfaces: Offers a web-based UI built with Streamlit (with persistent chat history) and an interactive command-line interface.
  • Multi-Provider Support: Utilizes either OpenAI or OpenRouter models as the LLM backend.
  • Vector Search: Uses pgvector for efficient semantic retrieval of relevant documentation.

Technical Requirements

  • Python 3.11+
  • PostgreSQL with pgvector extension (configured to run on port 54322)
  • OpenAI API key (required for embeddings and default LLM)
  • OpenRouter API key (optional, for alternative LLM providers)
  • Docker (optional, for running PostgreSQL with pgvector)

🛑 ReAgent Archival

ReAgent, an open-source end-to-end platform for applied reinforcement learning developed and used at Facebook, is officially archived and no longer maintained. For latest support on production-ready reinforcement learning, the developers direct users to Pearl, a production-ready RL AI Agent Library developed by the Applied Reinforcement Learning team at Meta.

Platform Details

  • Architecture: Built in Python, using PyTorch for modeling/training and TorchScript for model serving.
  • Use Case: Designed for large-scale, distributed recommendation/optimization tasks where a simulator is not accessible, relying on offline training on batches of data.
  • Methodology: Utilizes off-policy algorithms because policies update slowly and in batches.
  • Key Tools: Includes counterfactual policy evaluation (CPE) to test new policies without deployment, a Domain Analysis Tool to assess suitability for batch RL, and Behavior Cloning to bootstrap learning safely.
  • License: Released under a BSD 3-Clause license.

#PineScript #ReinforcementLearning #PydanticAI #TradingView #Meta #RL

item.title: Introduction of Pydantic AI and Pydantic AI Harness
item.description:
Introduction of Pydantic AI and Pydantic AI Harness

Pydantic AI has been released as a Python AI SDK providing a typed, extensible agent loop where models can be changed via a string swap.

🔍 Overview

The SDK allows the same agent to run across various environments, including:

  • Web frontends
  • Terminals
  • Voice calls
  • Durable background queues
  • GitHub Actions
  • As a plain object called via run()

🧩 How it works

Component Function
Pydantic AI Python AI SDK for typed data extraction and agent loops
Pydantic AI Harness Provides capabilities for complex, long-running work including memory, guardrails, planning, and storage
Pydantic Graph Separate package for typed control flow
Pydantic Evals Separate package for testing agent behavior similar to pytest
Pydantic Logfire AI observability platform for the entire app
Pydantic AI Gateway Model key management with real-time cost monitoring and budget control
genai-prices Maintains current model pricing
Monty Sandboxed Python interpreter for running model-written code

⚙️ Key details

  • Capabilities: Pydantic AI includes image generation and embeddings. Pydantic AI Harness can be used to build a complete coding agent featuring workspace-rooted file access, an allowlisted shell, repo orientation, and context management for long sessions.
  • Integration: The Gateway supports self-hosting and uses plain OpenTelemetry instrumentation, ensuring compatibility with existing backends.
  • Scope: The system supports a range of use cases from simple typed data extraction to complex multi-agent collaboration.

#PydanticAI #Python #AIAgents #LLM #SDK

Source: pydantic/pydantic-ai

item.title: Update on Full-Stack AI App Generator and Pydantic AI Ecosystem
item.description:
Update on Full-Stack AI App Generator and Pydantic AI Ecosystem

A production-ready full-stack AI app generator has been updated, providing a FastAPI and Next.js 15 project generator that includes AI agents, RAG, and over 20 enterprise integrations.

⚙️ Key details

Technical Specifications:

  • Python 3.11+
  • Powered by Pydantic AI
  • Next.js 15 with WebSocket streaming and real-time chat UI
  • Infrastructure: Docker, K8s, and Celery
  • Authentication: JWT and OAuth

Integrated Frameworks and Pipelines:

  • AI Agent Frameworks: PydanticAI, PydanticDeep, LangChain, LangGraph, and DeepAgents
  • RAG Pipeline options: Milvus, Qdrant, pgvector, and ChromaDB

🧩 How it works

Core Features:

  • Conversation Sharing: Includes public links, direct sharing, and an admin browser
  • Enterprise Tools: Admin panel and 20+ out-of-the-box integrations
  • CLI Capabilities: Claude Code-style CLI featuring a Docker sandbox, /improve command, multi-agent teams, and browser automation

Modular Components:

Component Function
pydantic-deepagents Modular agent runtime for Python; powers the deepagents framework option
pydantic-ai-shields Drop-in guardrails for Pydantic AI agents (5 infra and 5 content shields)
pydantic-ai-subagents Declarative multi-agent orchestration with token tracking
summarization-pydantic-ai Smart context compression for long-running agents
pydantic-ai-backend Sandboxed execution for AI agents using Docker and Daytona

#FastAPI #Nextjs #PydanticAI #AIAgents #RAG
